question: What should I do this week?
text:
ANSWER: Submit refund form and prepare to pay rent by Sun, Nov 1.
WHY:
- Refund of $1,850 arrives Thu, Nov 5 [C15].
- Paycheck of $401 arrives Tue, Nov 3 [C13].
- Rent leaves only $13.32 after payment [C3].
DO THIS:
1. Submit verification form so the $1,850 refund arrives Thu, Nov 5 [C15].
2. Pay rent of $725 on Sun, Nov 1 to avoid a $35 fee [C2][C4].
NOTE: Rent of $725 [C2] is due Sun, Nov 1 [C1] and leaves you just $13.32 [C3]. Last time, rent before payday cost a $35 fee [C4].
